# Welcome to Forge! 🔨
Thank you for installing Forge!
Forge is built for the community, with the goal of making software management more open, accessible, transparent, and user-friendly. We believe users should have control over their systems, their software, and their privacy.

## 🤝 Built for the Community
Forge is a community-oriented project. It aims to make software easier to discover, install, and manage while encouraging collaboration, transparency, and contributions from everyone.
Whether you're a developer, a Linux enthusiast, or simply someone who wants their software to work, Forge is being built with you in mind.

## 🔒 Privacy Comes First
Your privacy matters.
Forge aims to respect your privacy and minimize unnecessary data collection. We believe a package manager should help you manage your software without needlessly tracking your activity or compromising your personal information.

## 🛡️ Download Responsibly
Your system's security matters. Whenever possible, prefer official repositories, trusted maintainers, and verified upstream sources over unofficial or unknown downloads.
Be cautious of unofficial packages, modified archives, suspicious mirrors, and software from untrusted sources, as they may contain malicious code.
Always review package sources and build scripts when possible, and verify checksums or signatures when available.
**Forge is a tool, not a guarantee that every package is safe.** Community contributions and third-party software may carry risks. Stay informed about what you install.

## 📜 License Agreement
By installing and using Forge, you acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions of the license distributed with this software.
Please review the project's `LICENSE` file before continuing. If you do not agree to its terms, do not use or distribute Forge.
